Flatten nested BoundKey declarations before evaluation with outer explicit overrides. Preserve noninject constructor and NoInject missing-argument behavior, source provider exceptions and ordinary AssistedBuilder restrictions. comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
